reason: The first image-only reading was reread on the images with the Ulm edition at hand, which settled small numerals, abbreviations and partly covered words in the passages collated.
sources: [Guillelmus Parisiensis / Johannes Herolt], Postilla super epistolas et evangelia, Ulm: Johann Zainer, [c. 1478] (GW 11940; ISTC ig00650000; BSB-Ink H-139), Munich, BSB, 2 Inc.s.a. 567, scans 295-298 (page images), Dominica XIX post octavas Pentecostes, Gospel
GW 11940 and BSB-Ink H-139 catalogue entries, for the attributions
text:
F-xra7, source-assisted reading. A research reader reread all three visible faces of the leaf (canvases 2, 1 and 0) at native size, first against the image-only first reading and then, once the candidate was found, against the Ulm edition of about 1478 (GW 11940, Munich copy, scans 296-298). The small numerals of the opening ("31", "12", "24", "iiij") were read with the print open; "luna 24" could not be settled from the leaf alone. No blind check was made for this record. The script runs sideways in the images (turn a quarter turn counterclockwise). Native-pixel boxes are left, top, right, bottom. Expansions in parentheses, losses or supplements in square brackets, [label] = covered by a shelfmark label or glued strip, (?) = doubtful. Text order: canvas 2, hidden half (not visible), canvas 1, canvas 0.

Canvas 2 (Cod3560_Iv, flyleaf verso), box about 233,511,2659,3660, lines 1-19 (run on):
Hoc signu(m) fecit d(omi)n(u)s ih(es)us Anno ei(us) 31 12 kal(endas) sep(tembris) feria v luna 24 Ind(iccione) iiij. An(te) iniciu(m) p(rese)ntis ewang(e)lii scribit s(an)c(tu)s Marcus Q(uod) (Christ)o venienti in regione(m) Gerasenor(um) occurrit ei ho(mo) m(u)ltos h(abe)ns spiritus inmundos, qui sepius (com)pedib(us) et cathenis vinctus dirupit cathenas et (com)pedes co(m)minuit et nemo poterat domare, et semp(er) nocte ac die in monume(n)tis et montib(us) erat clama(n)s et (con)cidens se lapidib(us). Videns aut(em) ih(esu)m a longe cucurrit et adoravit eu(m), et int(er)rogavit eu(m) ih(esu)s Q(uo)d tibi no(men) e(st). Et dixit ei legio m(ih)i no(men) e(st) q(uia) multi su(mus). Erat ibi circa m[on]tem grex porcor(um) magnus pasce(n)s i(n) agris, et [depre]cabant(ur) eu(m) sp(iri)tus dicentes Si eicis nos hinc [m]itte nos i(n) porcos ut introeam(us) i(n) eos, et (con)[ces]sit eis ih(esu)s statim. Et exeu(n)tes sp(iri)tus inmun[di i]ntroierunt in porcos. Et [m]agno impetu [g]rex p(re)cipitat(us) e(st) i(n) mare a[d]
(Words under a glued strip in lines 13-17 are supplied in square brackets or not read.)

Canvas 1 (Cod3560_Ir, flyleaf recto), box about 312,346,2669,3585, lines 1-17 (run on):
boni medici qui p(ri)mo removet causam morbi et tu(n)c p(ost)modu(m) intendit curacioni. Et ecce quida(m) de scribis dixeru(n)t intra se hic blasphemat, i(d est) q(uo)d dei est sibi usurpat. Blas[label] e(st) deo aliq(ui)d attribue(re) q(uo)d sibi no(n) (con)ve[label] removere q(uo)d sibi (con)venit aut adt[label] q(uo)d deo p(ro)p(ri)um est s(cilicet) dimitte(re) aut(?) p(e)cc(at)a [label] Et cu(m) vidisset cogitac(i)o(n)es eor(um) dix[label co]gitatis mala i(n) cordib(us) v(est)ris. Quid [label] dimittu(n)t(ur) tibi p(e)cc(at)a tua, an dice(re) su[label] ut aut(em) sciatis q(uonia)m filius ho(min)is h[label di]mittendi p(e)cc(at)a, tu(n)c ait p(ar)alitico S[label l]ectu(m) tuu(m)
Box about 320,500,980,3420 (last five lines):
et vade i(n) domu(m) tua(m). et surrexit et abiit in domu(m) sua(m), In signu(m) p(er)fecte curacionis. Videntes aut(em) turbe, s(cilicet) miraculu(m) f(a)c(tu)m i(n) p(ar)alitico, timuer(un)t impone(re) blasphemia(m), et glorificaverunt deum qui ded[it po]test[atem ta]lem ho(min)ib(us), i(d est) ad salute(m)

Canvas 0 (Cod3560_VDS, pastedown), box about 204,354,2717,3699, lines 1-21 (run on):
[line 1, tops of letters only] ... [-]em(us) ex(emplum) i(n) mult[is] / [line 2] recipit(?) p[...] de [...] / cu(m) iurame(n)to nega(vit) (Christu)m et p(ost)ea flevit et (Christus) mi/sericordit(er) sibi indulsit et i(n) gradu(m) p(ri)stinu(m) restituit eu(m) ut p(ate)t Joh(ann)is 21o pasce oves meas. It(em) Maria Magdalena que multa p(e)cc(at)a (com)misit et p(ost)ea accessit cu(m) magna co(n)tric(i)o(n)e et fide ad (Christu)m et salvata e(st) Luce 7mo. It(em) Paulus p(er)secut(us) e(st) eccl(esi)am dei et Steph(anu)m iuvit lapida(r)e et p(ost)ea dixit d(omi)ne q(ui)d me vis face(re) Actuu(m) 9 et fact(us) [label doct]or genciu(m) et lume(n) eccl(es)ie. It(em) latro i(n) cruce antea [label l]atrocinia et scelera (com)misit et p(ost)ea dixit [label memen]to mei d(omi)ne etc. Luce 23 et (Christus) plus dedit ei [label]tivit: hodie mecu(m) eris i(n) p(ar)adiso. K(arissi)mi imi[label i]stos et no(n) sim(us) sic(ut) Iudas q(ui) de m(isericord)ia dei de[label] et laqueo se suspe(n)dit, i(n) quo deu(m) gravi(us) [label] (Christu)m p(ro) xxx denariis vendidit, un(de) de hoc [label] decretis Judas magis peccavit desp(er)ando q(ua)m [label] tradendo 23 q. iij(?) Si no(n) lic(et). No(n) etia(m) sicut [label] q(ui) ait maior e(st) i(ni)q(ui)tas mea q(ua)m ut venia(m) [mere]ar Gen. 4. un(de) B(er)nh(ar)dus Mentiris Caym maior [est dei pie]tas q(uam) quevis ini[quitas]
(Lines 1-2 are damaged at the fold; the words given there are isolated and uncertain. "Magdalena" is written with an interlinear addition and was read as a word, not letter by letter.)
